posts.title: Natvis-like experience with GDB pretty printers. Introduction

Natvis has become an inherent part of good debugging experience, but it is available only on Windows. This story is about my attempt to extend this experience to the Linux side. posts.title: Fast Debug in Visual C++
posts.description: It is well-known that Debug build in Visual C++ is very slow compared to Release build, with the typical ratio about 10-20 times. posts.title: On C++ code bloat
posts.description: The C++ language is known for its slow build times. This problem is not present in the world of pure C, which might give a hint that the problem is caused by some C++ feature. In fact, it is caused by bad habit or writing code in headers, severely worsened by C++ templates and inspired by STL itself.
